topic: Evaluation set before the overnight batch
situation: A pilot of 30 transcripts through the Message Batches API shows inconsistent dispositions and missing rationale fields. A PM wants to run all 35,000 now and resubmit bad rows tomorrow.
correct: C: build a representative evaluation set, refine the templated prompt against clear criteria, rerun, then submit the full batch.
why: Batches maximise savings only when first-pass success is high; prompt engineering is an evaluation loop and templates separate fixed instructions from {{transcript}} inputs.
observe: evidence/triage-triage_template_v0.json has a lower first-pass rate than evidence/triage-triage_template.json; only the latter reports ready_for_batch true.
rubric: first-pass success with v1 is 100% on the ten pilot transcripts
the learner can state why resubmitting bad rows tomorrow costs more than piloting
